objective: A schedule pointed at unauthorized production is refused when it is created
preconditions: a production environment that nobody has authorized for testing
expected: Refused with the security reason, at the moment somebody is looking at it — rather than failing silently every night once they are not
detail: 403 security_policy: Environment 'prod' is production and testing it has not been authorized. Authorize it explicitly with POST /api/v1/environments/{id}/authorize-production, with a note saying why.
